card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 16 That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 16 That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 16 / 16 Plus Sensor Array 1572864 or 524288 = charging port flex or the bottom mic / air pressure sensor module (often water damage; also check the Taptic Engine and FPC corrosion).
claims.evidence: Code mapping; the base iPhone 16 differs from the 16 Pro.

claims.statement: 2097152 = wireless charging flex on the back glass (its small IC is the important part).
169 = battery data line (usually stuck at 1% or showing 0% on charger): new battery, check connector, data line diode/voltage, replace U4000 and U4200 if needed.
3670016 = charging port plus wireless flex, or sandwich/CPU separation; a test point on that line should read about 0.350 in diode mode, OL means separation.

procedure: 1572864/524288: known-good charge flex; air pressure sensor connected; check Taptic and corrosion.
3670016: check both flexes, then diode-check the sandwich test point (~0.350, OL = separation).

measurements.context: OL indicates sandwich or CPU separation

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Charge port flex / air sensor / wireless flex / battery data
